## 席位核对 — REWORK · repo:objectstack#3 · head 7ea3843e · 2026-11-24T05:13Z

L1 read of #36848 against card #36692 (the maintainer's ruling 「照 Twenty 分开」). Head `7ea3843ecf10e5c1ee1e27d8cc11f8ff88428557`. Dev report 7122693249.

**Face.** `l1-face.mjs --pr 36848` CLEAN (13 items read, none flagged). At this head: 45 checks succeed, 13 skip as expected, 0 fail. `mergeable_state` clean. `check-governed-merges.mjs` says NOT governed (0 of 31 paths; 1691 changed lines). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

**Read and sound.**
- Slot removal: `designModeReportSlot.ts` and its 36364 test are deleted, not left unused. The `report` kind of `designModeMenuCreate.ts`, the slot block in `DesignModeMenu.tsx` and the slot branch in `ReportNewPage.tsx` are gone. No reader of `designMode.menu.newReport`, `designMode.menu.newReportLeft`, `report.builder.addsToMenu` or `designModeReportSlot` remains under `ui/`, `apps/`, `packages/`, `content/` or `skills/`; the only hits are the history comments in `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`. No docs or skills page teaches "New report…" from design mode, so `Skills-docs` is honestly not owed.
- Index: 「New report」 sits in the `PageHeader` actions. It is gated `isResolved && isAdmin && !designing`, the same admin gate as the builder.
- Exclusion, mode on → editors off: `useDashboardEditOffered` and the `ReportView` header Edit read `useDesignModeActive()`. The report-builder arrival is skipped while designing.
- Exclusion, editor open → mode refused: `holdOut()` is a counter with an idempotent release. `enter()` returns `false` with the `designMode.editorOpen` toast while it is above 0. The dashboard edit state, the `ReportView` builder and panel (open or opening), and `ReportNewPage` each hold it through `useHoldDesignModeOut`, an effect whose cleanup lets go on close or unmount. The pins cover one editor, two editors and unmount-while-open. Ablation 1 (the `heldOut > 0` test flipped) turns 7 pins red across 5 files.
- The `de-quote-pairing-3876` count moves 134→133 for the one retired `newReportLeft` pair. The textual overlap with #36791 is known; whichever PR lands second re-counts.

**Finding.**

- **S1. `ReportNewPage` drawn while the design mode is already on still shows two Save/Cancel sets, and the bar's Cancel ends the mode under the open builder.** The page only holds the mode out, and a hold refuses only a later `enter()`. Nothing stops the builder from drawing when the mode is already on. Hiding the index's 「New report」 covers the link but not the address, and the module header says the mode goes along on a link to another page of the same app. A reachable path: open the builder from the index, Close (it pushes the index), enter 「Design layout」, then press the browser's Back. That lands on `reports/new` with the mode on, which is the card's double-bar screen, item 2. Two texts this round wrote are then untrue: the changeset sentence "so the design mode's 「Cancel」 can no longer end the mode under an editor left open", and the card's Expected, "At any moment the screen shows exactly one Save/Cancel set". The silent wrong result of item 3 is gone with the slot: a save now makes a plain report, which is what the builder says. The model the ruling points to closes this side: Twenty's `useSetIsPageLayoutInEditMode` ignores an edit request while customization is on. **Fix** (one route, dev's choice of wording): while `useDesignModeActive()` is true, `ReportNewPage` does not draw the builder. It can draw the same prompt as an `Empty`, or send the reader back to the reports index with it. Pin it with a "mode on, then `reports/new` mounts → no builder, no second Save" case and a control where the mode is off. `ReportView`'s already-guarded Edit and arrival need nothing.

Notes (nit, no action required):
- N1. While designing, `ReportView` skips the arrival without consuming it. If the mode ends while the reader is still on that report, the effect runs again and the builder opens then. That is arguably right (the arrival was for this report), but it isn't pinned.
- N2. `enter()` now returns `boolean`. No caller outside `SidebarAppMenu` reads it today, so the widening is free.

Delta read owed on the head that carries S1.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#3 · head cccd0173 · 2026-11-24T06:33Z

Delta read of #36848 (card #36692) against my REWORK 7122753474 @7ea3843e. New head `cccd01739c9bcfc6cb1c512133d63455c935cf9d`; the dev's delta report is 7123653672.

**Delta.** `git diff 7ea3843e cccd0173` touches 14 files: `ReportNewPage.tsx`, its 36692 test, the changeset, and two keys in each of the 11 packs. Main was not merged, so everything read at 7ea3843e still stands.

- **S1: closed.** `ReportNewPage` now reads `useDesignModeActive()`. While the mode is on it draws an `Empty` (`report.builder.designModeOnTitle` / `designModeOn`) in place of `ReportBuilderHost`, and it holds the mode out only while it draws the builder (`isResolved && isAdmin && !designing`). Reached by the browser's Back with the mode on, the page now shows the mode's bar and a prompt: one Save/Cancel set. Saving or cancelling the mode draws the builder in place, which then holds the mode out, so a later `enter()` refuses. The new guard sits after the loading and admin-only returns, so a non-admin still sees the admin-only text. Pins: mode on then mount (no builder, no second Save), then Cancel (builder drawn, a later `enter()` refused), plus a mode-off control. The ablation of `if (designing)` turns the mode-on pin red.
- The changeset gains one bullet that matches the diff, and its key list now names the two new keys. The changeset sentence I flagged ("can no longer end the mode under an editor left open") is now true on every path I know of, including the address reached with the mode on.

**Face.** `l1-face.mjs --pr 36848` CLEAN at this head. 47 checks succeed, 15 skip as expected, 0 fail. `mergeable_state` clean. It remains NOT governed.

No must-fix, no should-fix. N1 and N2 from 7122753474 stand as optional notes. #36858 is queued and overlaps in `DesignModeMenu.tsx` / `designModeMenuCreate.ts`. If it lands first, the merged head owes a short delta read limited to the merge resolution.
